name: page-dots
title: Page Dots
description: Page dots that follow the scroll: a worm that stretches to the next page, or a dot that widens into a pill.

perf.budget: Reads the scroll position as a shared value on the UI thread, so it follows the finger without re-rendering. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Driven by the scroll, it still follows the finger; without a scroll position it jumps between pages.
a11y.screenReader: An adjustable value ("Page, 2 of 5") whose increment and decrement ask for the next and previous page.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole row is the target, 44 pt tall; a tap picks the nearest dot.
